remarks: Opportunity Knocks! Refreshed 3 bedroom 2.5 bath spacious raised ranch in a private wooded North Stamford setting to enjoy all that nature has to offer. The interior has been freshly painted and wood floors have been polished getting it ready for the next chapter with a new owner. The main level offers a living room, dining area and eat-in-kitchen with slider to deck along with 3 bedrooms. The lower level has a spacious family room with fireplace, office/den, and sunroom complete with bar. If you are looking for a home that offers great space and is ready for the new owner to put their own touches on kitchen and baths, this could be the one! Don't miss it! This is. an estate so no property disclosures sold "As Is"
